note: Example channel profile. Copy this folder OUTSIDE the engine, to AI agent/channels/<slug>/ (one folder per channel), put the channel's own files next to channel.json, and a project names it with "profile": "<slug>". Everything here stays the same from video to video (decision 10: logo, end screen, title card); everything else varies.
name: Example channel

title_card.music: own sting in the source sound (no added music)

disclosure.altered_or_synthetic_content: tick when a video has AI images or AI music
